# LOAD DATA
```{r}
# Load Dataset
df_raw <- read_excel("PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_FINAL_CLEAN.xlsx")

# 1. Dimensi Data
dim_info <- data.frame(
  Metrik = c("Jumlah Baris (Observasi)", "Jumlah Kolom (Peubah)"),
  Nilai = c(nrow(df_raw), ncol(df_raw))
)
kable(dim_info, caption = "Tabel 1.1: Dimensi Dataset")

# 2. Cek Missing Value & Tipe Data
health_df <- data.frame(
  Kolom = colnames(df_raw),
  Tipe_Data = sapply(df_raw, function(x) paste(class(x), collapse = ", ")),
  Jumlah_NA = sapply(df_raw, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  Persen_NA = sapply(df_raw, function(x) sprintf("%.2f%%", mean(is.na(x)) * 100))
)
kable(health_df, caption = "Tabel 1.2: Validasi Tipe Data & Missing Values")
```

```{r}
str(df_raw)
```

# CLEANING DATAA

```{r}
# 2. DATA CLEANING PIPELINE
df_clean <- df_raw %>%
  # a. Buang kolom redundan / zero variance & duplikasi kecamatan
  select(-Kategori, -Nama_Bursa_Mobil, -Kecamatan) %>%
  
  # b. Bersihkan karakter tak kasat mata (\xa0) & trim spasi liar pada kolom string
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_squish(str_replace_all(., "\xa0", " ")))) %>%
  
  # c. Konversi variabel kategorik nominal menjadi factor
  mutate(across(c(Provinsi, Kota_Kabupaten, Merk, Model, Brand_Tier, 
                  Tipe_Bahan_Bakar, Transmisi, Tipe_Bodi, Warna, Tipe_Penjual), as.factor)) %>%
  
  # d. Konversi Odometer_Group menjadi Ordered Factor agar urutan plot tidak acak
  mutate(Odometer_Group = factor(Odometer_Group, 
                                 levels = c("<20k (Sangat Low)", 
                                            "20k-50k (Low)", 
                                            "50k-100k (Sedang)", 
                                            ">100k (Tinggi)"), 
                                 ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  
  # e. Rekalkulasi & jamin konsistensi Usia_Mobil
  mutate(Usia_Mobil = as.integer(2026 - Tahun))

# 3. CEK STRUKTUR HASIL PEMBERSIHAN
glimpse(df_clean)

# 4. EKSPOR KE FILE EXCEL BARU
write_xlsx(df_clean, "PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_CLEANED_V2.xlsx")
```

# EKSPLORASI DATA

## 1. Ringkasan Statistik Deskriptif (Peubah Numerik)

```{r stat-deskriptif}
# Fungsi untuk menghitung ringkasan statistik lengkap
get_num_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(Harga_IDR, Usia_Mobil, Jarak_Tempuh_KM, Kapasitas_Mesin_CC) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      Mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = ~ median(., na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR = ~ IQR(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = ~ min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = ~ max(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Skewness = ~ e1071::skewness(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                        names_to = c("Variabel", "Metrik"), 
                        names_sep = "__") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Metrik, values_from = value)
}

num_summary <- get_num_summary(df_clean)

kable(num_summary, digits = 2, caption = "Tabel 2.1: Ringkasan Statistik Deskriptif Peubah Numerik")
```

## 2. Eksplorasi Distribusi Peubah Numerik
### 2.1 Sebaran Harga Mobil (Harga_IDR)

```{r}
# p1: Dibagi 1e6 supaya nilainya pas dalam jutaan (Juta Rp)
p1 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Harga_IDR / 1e6)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2c3e50", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Harga Mobil (Skala Asli)",
       x = "Harga (Juta Rp)", 
       y = "Frekuensi") +
  theme_minimal()

# p2: Skala Log10 dengan format Rupiah yang rapi
p2 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Harga_IDR)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#e74c3c", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_dollar(prefix = "Rp ", big.mark = ".")) +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Harga Mobil (Skala Log10)",
       x = "Harga (Skala Log IDR)", 
       y = "Frekuensi") +
  theme_minimal()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```

### 2.2 Sebaran Usia, Jarak Tempuh, dan Kapasitas Mesin
```{r}
# Usia Mobil
p_usia <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Usia_Mobil)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#3498db", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Usia Mobil", x = "Usia (Tahun)", y = "Frekuensi") +
  theme_minimal()

# Jarak Tempuh (KM)
p_km <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Jarak_Tempuh_KM / 1000)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2ecc71", color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Jarak Tempuh", x = "Jarak Tempuh (Ribu KM)", y = "Frekuensi") +
  theme_minimal()

# Kapasitas Mesin (CC)
p_cc <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Kapasitas_Mesin_CC)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#9b59b6", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribusi Kapasitas Mesin", x = "Kapasitas Mesin (CC)", y = "Frekuensi") +
  theme_minimal()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_usia, p_km, p_cc, ncol = 3)
```

### 2.3 Deteksi Pencilan (Outlier) dengan Boxplot
```{r}
p_box0 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(y = Harga_IDR)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot Harga", y = "Harga") +
  theme_minimal()

p_box1 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(y = log10(Harga_IDR))) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot Log(Harga)", y = "Log10(Harga)") +
  theme_minimal()

p_box2 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(y = Usia_Mobil)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot Usia Mobil", y = "Tahun") +
  theme_minimal()

p_box3 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(y = Jarak_Tempuh_KM)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#2ecc71", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot Jarak Tempuh", y = "KM") +
  theme_minimal()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_box0, p_box1, p_box2, p_box3, ncol = 4)
```

## 3. Eksplorasi Variabel Kategorik
### 3.1 Top 10 Merk Mobil Terbanyak
```{r}
df_clean %>%
  count(Merk, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Merk, n), y = n, fill = Merk)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Merk Mobil Paling Banyak Dijual",
       x = "Merk Mobil", y = "Jumlah Unit") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d()
```

p_trans <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Transmisi, fill = Transmisi)) +

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_tier, p_trans, p_bbm, ncol = 3)

## 4. Analisis Bivariat & Korelasi
### 4.1 Matriks Korelasi Peubah Numerik

```{r}
# Ambil peubah numerik
num_data <- df_clean %>% 
  select(Harga_IDR, Usia_Mobil, Jarak_Tempuh_KM, Kapasitas_Mesin_CC)

cor_matrix <- cor(num_data, use = "complete.obs")

# Heatmap Korelasi sederhanan
ggcorrplot::ggcorrplot(cor_matrix, 
                       hc.order = TRUE, 
                       type = "lower", 
                       lab = TRUE, 
                       lab_size = 4, 
                       colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"),
                       title = "Matriks Korelasi Peubah Numerik")
```

### 4.2 Hubungan Usia Mobil vs Harga Jual (berdasarkan Brand Tier)
```{r}
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Usia_Mobil, y = Harga_IDR / 1e6, color = Brand_Tier)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Pengaruh Usia Mobil Terhadap Harga per Brand Tier",
       x = "Usia Mobil (Tahun)", 
       y = "Harga (Juta Rp - Skala Log10)",
       color = "Brand Tier") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 4.3 Harga Mobil Berdasarkan Transmisi & Brand Tier
```{r}
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Brand_Tier, y = Harga_IDR / 1e6, fill = Transmisi)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Perbandingan Harga Berdasarkan Brand Tier dan Transmisi",
       x = "Brand Tier", 
       y = "Harga (Juta Rp - Skala Log10)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
